projectName: Silverline Board & Financial Results RAG Assistant
projectDescription: A source-grounded chat application for the explicitly illustrative Silverline board minutes, outcome, auditor review report, resolutions register, and financial-results workbook supplied in docs/.

services.name: Chat interface
services.description: Next.js and TypeScript user interface for source-grounded chat, citations, and document-aware interaction; deployed to Vercel.

services.name: Chat orchestration API
services.description: Next.js Route Handlers for chat orchestration, hybrid retrieval, model calls, and cited responses; deployed with the Next.js application to Vercel.

services.name: Document ingestion job
services.description: Separate Python CLI/job using Docling to parse the supplied PDF, DOCX, and XLSX corpus and index chunks, metadata, and structured spreadsheet facts.

questions.question: Which language should the chat interface use?
questions.rationale: The agreed UI architecture specifies Next.js with TypeScript.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for the Next.js interface.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the chat interface use?
questions.rationale: Next.js is the agreed framework and supports the selected Vercel deployment target.

options.label: Next.js
options.description: React framework with integrated routing and Vercel deployment support.

questions.question: What should the chat interface include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive source-grounded chat with document citations, source references, and clear indication when the corpus does not support an answer.
questions.answer: Responsive source-grounded chat with document citations, source references, and clear indication when the corpus does not support an answer.
questions.rationale: Cited, appropriately bounded answers are central to a trustworthy document assistant.

questions.question: Which language should the chat orchestration API use?
questions.rationale: The agreed API uses Next.js Route Handlers, sharing the TypeScript application runtime.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for Next.js Route Handlers.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Standard JavaScript for Next.js Route Handlers.

questions.question: Which framework should power the chat orchestration API?
questions.rationale: The agreed design explicitly uses Next.js Route Handlers and does not include FastAPI.

options.label: Next.js Route Handlers
options.description: API endpoints co-located with the Next.js application.

questions.question: What should the chat orchestration API do?
questions.recommendedChoice: Retrieve relevant narrative chunks and structured spreadsheet facts using Supabase Postgres pgvector and full-text search; call Gemini Flash as the primary model and Cloudflare Workers AI for open-weight embeddings and fallback text generation; return grounded responses with precise source citations and abstain when evidence is insufficient.
questions.answer: Retrieve relevant narrative chunks and structured spreadsheet facts using Supabase Postgres pgvector and full-text search; call Gemini Flash as the primary model and Cloudflare Workers AI for open-weight embeddings and fallback text generation; return grounded responses with precise source citations and abstain when evidence is insufficient.
questions.rationale: These model and retrieval choices are part of the agreed architecture.

questions.question: Which language should the document ingestion job use?
questions.rationale: The agreed ingestion job is Python-based and uses Docling.

questions.question: Which document-processing framework should the ingestion job use?
questions.rationale: Docling is the agreed parser for PDF, DOCX, and XLSX sources.

options.label: Docling
options.description: Document parsing toolkit for the supplied office and PDF formats.

questions.question: What should the document ingestion job process and index?
questions.recommendedChoice: Use Docling to ingest the supplied PDF, DOCX, and XLSX files; preserve document, page, sheet, and row context; index narrative chunks, metadata, and structured spreadsheet facts in Supabase Postgres for vector and full-text retrieval.
questions.answer: Use Docling to ingest the supplied PDF, DOCX, and XLSX files; preserve document, page, sheet, and row context; index narrative chunks, metadata, and structured spreadsheet facts in Supabase Postgres for vector and full-text retrieval.
questions.rationale: The corpus includes both narrative reports and tabular financial facts requiring traceable source context.

questions.question: Which data stores should the app use?
questions.rationale: The agreed architecture stores searchable chunks, metadata, and structured spreadsheet facts in Supabase Postgres; the corpus is supplied locally for ingestion, with no separate file-storage service specified.

options.label: Supabase Postgres (pgvector and full-text search)
options.description: Store document chunks, metadata, structured spreadsheet facts, vector embeddings, and full-text indexes.

options.label: Blob or object storage
options.description: Persist and serve uploaded or application-managed source files.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use no persistent file, database, or search storage.

questions.question: Should users sign in to use the chatbot?
questions.rationale: The user confirmed public MVP access with no sign-in; the supplied corpus is explicitly illustrative.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require users to sign in before using the application.
